title: Ecosystem, certifications, and the calendar
blurb: Credly badges without invented exam codes, the release cadence, and how to read a date that disagrees with the next page.

lessons.title: Only the badges this lab opened
lessons.summary: Credly lists NCIE CXone ACD/IVR, NCIE CXone Mpower Digital Experience, NCAP CXone Mpower Workforce Management, NCAP CXone Mpower Personal Connection, and CXone Supervisor Certification. Exam codes are not on those badges.

p: The ACD/IVR badge is NCIE CXone ACD/IVR. Its badge text also uses the CXone Mpower ACD/IVR wording. Digital Experience has its own NCIE badge. WFM and Personal Connection are NCAP badges and describe an instructor-led course plus an assessment.

The supervisor badge is CXone Supervisor Certification. This lab did not find public exam codes on these Credly pages. Do not invent one. Availability and cost change. Re-open the badge before you tell someone they can sit it.

choices: A free Club One quiz only
Not published. Do not invent them.
quiz.why: The badges we opened did not show a public code.

cards.back: Also worded Mpower on the badge.

lessons.title: The supervisor badge comes through Club One
lessons.summary: CXone Supervisor Certification is free and foundational. Its scope names WFM, QM, Dashboard, Coaching, and Gamification. Club One is the supervisor community that hosts it, not a catalog of every technical exam.
objectives: Keep Club One in its lane

p: The Credly badge for CXone Supervisor Certification describes a free foundational certification reached through Club One. The topics named are WFM, QM, Dashboard, Coaching, and Gamification.
That is a supervisor's map of the floor. It does not replace the NCIE or NCAP badges, and it does not publish the QM form this campus refused to invent.

lessons.title: How a release reaches a cluster
lessons.summary: Coming Soon starts about 30 days before beta. Final notes land on or just before beta. Customer clusters start about two weeks after beta, in groups. Control updates are about every three weeks. A major release is about four times a year. Dates are not guaranteed.
objectives: Distrust a notification date that the page will not guarantee

p: The release-process page describes Coming Soon about 30 days before beta, final notes on or just before beta, and customer clusters starting about two weeks after beta, in groups. Control updates and the pipeline are about every three weeks. Hotfixes are as needed. A major release is about four times a year.
The notification timeline says notification dates are not guaranteed. A date in a slide is a target until the page you are looking at says it happened.

lessons.title: 26.2 is a cycle with a rename table
lessons.summary: The 26.2 cycle begins 29 April 2026 and the next cycle was targeted for 28 July 2026. Features can change. A rename example is CXone Mpower for Service Cloud Voice to Unified App for Salesforce Voice.
objectives: Treat names as a table you re-read

p: The 26.2 release notes say the cycle begins 29 April 2026 and that the next cycle was then targeted for 28 July 2026. Features are subject to change, and a license or a preview may be required.
Those are cycle dates, not the Salesforce Agent package dates.

The notes include a rename table. One row is CXone Mpower for Service Cloud Voice becoming Unified App for Salesforce Voice, with 7 April among the dates on that table. Digital Experience naming is also in that conversation.
Confirm the live table before you enforce a name in a design. MAX is still a name in current help. This lab does not say MAX was removed.

lessons.title: 26.3 and 26.4 disagree if you force one calendar
lessons.summary: 26.3 moved to 2 September 2026 through 5 November 2026. Coming Soon for 26.4 begins 26 October 2026 and targets 4 February 2027. Those windows overlap. Controlled Release becomes Public Preview in 26.3. This lab does not resolve the overlap.

p: The 26.3 notes say the cycle was originally 3 August 2026 to 25 October 2026 and, after a moratorium, 2 September 2026 to 5 November 2026. Features can change.
Coming Soon for 26.4 says that cycle begins 26 October 2026 and the next was targeted for 4 February 2027. 26 October falls inside the 26.3 end date. This lab will not decide which sentence wins.
Starting with 26.3, Controlled Release is renamed Public Preview. The notes say a license or a public preview signup may be required.

French 25.4 notes were readable when the English 25.4 page returned 404. Those French notes say that cycle starts 29 October 2025 and the next was targeted for 29 January 2026, and they name SAML IdP-initiated sign-in with Entra ID and OneLogin. Treat the English wording as uncertain.

lessons.title: How to keep reading after this campus
lessons.summary: Re-open the page, prefer the sentence that names a version or a field, and mark a conflict instead of smoothing it. This campus is independent study. It is not NiCE, and the Studio export is not an official script.

p: When two official sentences disagree, this campus quotes both. Priority pages, OIDC samples, release windows, and connector versions are the practice cases.
A feature in release notes may need a license or a public preview. A date on a notification is not guaranteed. A sample host is not your host.
This campus is an independent study floor. It is not affiliated with NiCE. Logs and names in the incidents are synthetic. Classics, Inc. appears only when a help page uses it as an example.

The script builder's JSON sets notOfficialStudioExport. The routing simulator implements the documented priority formula for practice, including a classroom tie-break that is not a cited inbound policy.
